headline: Attackers weaponized freshly disclosed flaws across WordPress, SharePoint, Fortinet, and SonicWall as CISA set emergency patch deadlines and two Fortune 500 firms disclosed breaches.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep compressing the window between disclosure and exploitation, turning fresh SharePoint, Fortinet, and SonicWall bugs into working intrusions within days of their fixes.
emerging_trends.topic_title: CISA Flags Exploited SharePoint, Fortinet, and SonicWall Flaws

emerging_trends.text: Prompt injection is maturing into the cross-site scripting of the agent era, as browser agents from Google's Gemini onward read stranger-supplied page content as commands.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Web Agents Face Prompt Injection

emerging_trends.text: Third-party support systems keep opening enterprises to theft, with Ernst & Young tracing its breach to a compromised ticketing vendor and Abbott probing legacy platforms it inherited.

topics.title: CISA Flags Exploited SharePoint, Fortinet, and SonicWall Flaws
topics.latest_developments: CISA added SharePoint Server deserialization flaw CVE-2026-58644, rated 9.8, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a July 19 fix deadline, ordered agencies to patch two exploited Fortinet FortiSandbox flaws by Sunday, and Dark Reading tied the Inc ransomware crew to a chain of two SonicWall SMA zero-days that yields root.
topics.summary: Attackers are weaponizing freshly disclosed enterprise flaws within days; federal agencies and enterprises running SharePoint, FortiSandbox, and SonicWall SMA appliances should patch on the emergency timelines.

sources.title: CISA Adds Exploited SharePoint RCE Zero-Day CVE-2026-58644 to KEV
Fresh SharePoint Vulnerability Exploited Soon After Disclosure
CISA urges immediate action on actively exploited Fortinet flaws
Inc Ransomware Exploits SonicWall SMA Zero-Days

topics.title: AI Web Agents Face Prompt Injection
topics.latest_developments: A UC Berkeley team named Cross-Site Prompting, or XSP, the web-agent version of cross-site scripting and built a mediator called Prismata to block it, Google's Gemini let strangers send messages from a locked Android phone, and Harvard Kennedy School and Meta researchers found a convincing script carries AI voice phishing further than the synthetic voice itself.
topics.summary: Autonomous browser agents read stranger-supplied page text as instructions, opening a class of attacks defenders liken to XSS; teams deploying web agents should constrain what content the agent trusts.

sources.title: Prompt injection is becoming the XSS of the web agent era
Google's Gemini lets strangers send messages from your locked Android phone
The script, not the voice, is what makes AI voice phishing work

topics.title: Abbott and Ernst & Young Breaches
topics.latest_developments: Abbott Laboratories opened two investigations—one into unauthorized access of legacy Exact Sciences systems in its cancer-diagnostics unit, another into an extortion claim that attackers breached its LabCentral portal—and Ernst & Young began notifying customers of a breach it traced to a compromised third-party support-ticket system its IT staff used.
topics.summary: Two large firms disclosed intrusions reaching through legacy and third-party systems; Abbott and Ernst & Young customers should watch for breach notices.

sources.title: Abbott probes two cyber incidents amid extortion claims
Ernst & Young discloses data breach after support system hack

topics.title: wp2shell WordPress Core Zero-Day
topics.latest_developments: Adam Kues of Assetnote, Searchlight Cyber's attack-surface arm, found wp2shell, a WordPress core flaw that runs code from a single anonymous HTTP request, exposing every 6.9 and 7.0 site until WordPress shipped 6.9.5 and 7.0.2 on Friday and forced the updates through its auto-update system.
topics.summary: The flaw sits in WordPress core, so even a bare install with no plugins runs attacker code from one unauthenticated request; administrators should confirm their sites took the forced 6.9.5 or 7.0.2 update.

sources.title: New wp2shell WordPress Core Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code

topics.title: North Korea Hides OtterCookie in SVG Coding Tests
topics.latest_developments: Researchers caught Contagious Interview operators using steganography in SVG image files, rendered as flags, to smuggle a four-stage OtterCookie payload into fake coding challenges, dropping a browser-credential and crypto-wallet stealer plus a file stealer on job seekers who ran the project.
topics.summary: North Korea-linked actors keep weaponizing fake job postings and coding tests; developers should treat unsolicited take-home projects and their image assets as hostile.

sources.title: Fake Coding Tests Deliver OtterCookie-Aligned Malware Hidden in SVG Flag Images

topics.title: GoSerpent Espionage in Southeast Asia
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky uncovered GoSerpent, a previously undocumented malware that has hit government and diplomatic entities across Southeast Asia since late 2025, built for long-term access and intelligence gathering.
topics.summary: The espionage tool focuses on persistence and data collection against regional governments; affected agencies should hunt for the associated implants.

sources.title: New GoSerpent Malware Targets Southeast Asian Governments and Diplomats for Espionage

business_politics.title: U.S.-Iran War Widens to Gulf Infrastructure
business_politics.latest_developments: American and Iranian forces traded strikes on infrastructure Friday, July 17—U.S. bombs hit bridges and Iran hit a water plant—and Iran began firing on neighboring Gulf states as Yemen's Houthis renewed threats to close Saudi Arabia's Red Sea export route, raising the risk of a wider spiral.
business_politics.summary: The United States and Iran have fought an escalating war over the Strait of Hormuz for weeks, and crude oil posted double-digit weekly gains as the fighting spread across the Persian Gulf; House Republicans meanwhile pressed a military-funding package smaller than the boost President Trump wants, its passage uncertain amid party divisions.

sources.title: The U.S. and Iran Creep Toward a Wider War With Escalating Attacks
The Threat to Saudi Arabia's Main Oil-Export Route Is Growing
Oil Futures Rise on Middle East Escalation Fears
GOP Package to Fund Iran War Runs Into Republican Doubts

business_politics.title: Chip Stocks Post Worst Week in Over a Year
business_politics.latest_developments: U.S. semiconductor shares capped their worst week in more than a year Friday, July 17, as crowded momentum trades unwound, Netflix plunged on a growth warning, and Apple briefly overtook Nvidia as the most valuable U.S. company.
business_politics.summary: A deepening selloff in Nvidia and other chipmakers, stoked by fresh competition from China's Moonshot AI, dragged the Nasdaq lower and ended a punishing week for the technology stocks that led the market, with Netflix's drop compounding the pressure.

sources.title: US chip stocks notch up worst week in more than a year
Nasdaq Drops Again as Chip Slump Deepens
U.S. Chip Stocks Extend Slide; Netflix Tumbles on Growth Warning
Apple briefly leapfrogs Nvidia as world's most valuable company

business.title: Youngwood Building Collapse Shutters Businesses
business.latest_developments: Fences, caution tape, and traffic cones still block Depot Street in Youngwood after a building collapsed there, keeping nearby businesses closed for weeks, WPXI reported July 17.
business.summary: A building collapse in the Westmoreland County borough of Youngwood has closed Depot Street and forced surrounding businesses to shut down, with no reopening date set.

sources.title: Businesses closed for weeks after building collapses in Westmoreland County

business.title: Unity Township Mini-Golf Course Reborn
business.latest_developments: Tom and Lisa Bihon are transforming the long-abandoned Charlie's Ballgame along Route 30 in Unity Township into Charlie's Hideout Putt and Hit, a mini-golf and batting-cage complex, KDKA reported July 17.
business.summary: The miniature-golf course sat abandoned for nearly 25 years in Unity Township, Westmoreland County; the Bihons, who played there as children, are reopening it as Charlie's Hideout Putt and Hit.

sources.title: Abandoned mini golf course in Westmoreland County getting new life

business.title: Achieva Program Puts Disabled Workers on the Job
business.latest_developments: KDKA profiled July 17 a Pennsylvania employment program run by Achieva that placed Jack Hartley assembling boxes at Grandpa Joe's Candy's warehouse in Robinson Township, part of a broader push to bring people with disabilities into the workforce.
business.summary: The state-supported Achieva program helps people with disabilities find paying jobs; Hartley has worked for two and a half months building shipping boxes at the Grandpa Joe's warehouse in Robinson Township.

sources.title: First job gives Pittsburgh-area man with disabilities newfound confidence

around_town.title: Cyclospora Outbreak Traced to Taco Bell Lettuce
around_town.latest_developments: The CDC confirmed Friday, July 17, that the multistate cyclosporiasis outbreak traces to iceberg lettuce from a single central-Mexico farm supplied to Taco Bell, prompting Taylor Fresh Foods to pull all iceberg lettuce from the region.
around_town.summary: The parasitic outbreak, which the Allegheny County Health Department flagged locally with 11 confirmed cases, sickened thousands across more than 30 states; an FDA traceback pointed to Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce used by Taco Bell locations in Indiana, Kentucky, Michigan, Ohio, and West Virginia.

sources.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak traced to lettuce from Mexico used by Taco Bell, CDC says
Taylor Farms pulls iceberg lettuce linked to cyclosporiasis outbreak

around_town.title: PennWest President Departs for Utah
around_town.latest_developments: Pennsylvania Western University president Jon Anderson will step down in August to become president of Utah Valley University, TribLive and the Post-Gazette reported July 17.
around_town.summary: Jon Anderson leads PennWest, the state system's merged university, and now leaves the post for the presidency of Utah Valley University in Orem, Utah.

sources.title: PennWest president steps down, heads to Utah Valley University
PennWest president to lead Utah university

around_town.title: Severe Storms to Clear the Smoke Saturday
around_town.latest_developments: Forecasters made Saturday, July 18, a Severe Weather Alert Day for Western Pennsylvania, calling for strong to severe storms that will wash out the wildfire smoke behind the statewide Code Purple air-quality alert.
around_town.summary: Wildfire smoke from Canada and Minnesota pushed Pennsylvania into a Code Purple 'very unhealthy' alert Friday, closing Kennywood and Sandcastle and postponing the Pirates' game in Cleveland; storms arriving late Saturday will clear the haze.

sources.title: Strong to severe storms Saturday in Western Pennsylvania
Western PA: Strong to severe storms arrive late Saturday

events.title: Pittsburgh Vintage Grand Prix Runs Sunday
events.latest_developments: The 44th Pittsburgh Vintage Grand Prix holds its race Sunday, July 19, KDKA previewed July 17, with organizers watching whether lingering wildfire smoke affects the weekend.
events.summary: The Pittsburgh Vintage Grand Prix, one of the world's premier vintage motorsports events, runs its 44th annual race Sunday, July 19, capping a weekend of vintage-car competition.

sources.title: Pittsburgh Vintage Grand Prix back for 44th race weekend
14+ things to do this weekend, from Picklesburgh to the Pittsburgh Vintage Grand Prix

around_teams.title: Porter Jr.'s Hold-In Looms Over Steelers Camp
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette examined July 17 how the hold-in—reporting to camp but sitting out practice—has become the Steelers' negotiating tactic of choice, and what the team's history with it signals for cornerback Joey Porter Jr.'s stalled contract talks.
around_teams.summary: Joey Porter Jr. wants a new deal as cornerback salaries surge across the NFL; Post-Gazette writers traced the hold-in from Le'Veon Bell's era to Porter's situation as Steelers training camp nears in Latrobe.

sources.title: How the hold-in has become the ploy of choice for Steelers with stalled contract talks
WATCH: What does the Steelers' hold-in history tell us about the Joey Porter Jr. situation?

around_teams.title: Rotation Will Decide the Pirates' Season
around_teams.latest_developments: Post-Gazette columnist Noah Hiles argued July 17 that the Pirates' starting rotation—Paul Skenes, Braxton Ashcraft, Bailey Jones, and Mitch Keller—will ultimately determine how far the team goes in its wild-card push.
around_teams.summary: The Pirates lean on a young rotation fronted by ace Paul Skenes and All-Star Braxton Ashcraft; Hiles wrote that its performance sets the ceiling for the second half as Pittsburgh chases a playoff berth.

sources.title: Noah Hiles: The Pirates' starting rotation will ultimately determine how far they go

around_teams.title: Freiermuth Poised for Bigger Steelers Role
around_teams.latest_developments: A Post-Gazette training-camp countdown argued July 17 that tight end Pat Freiermuth should finally become a central piece of the Steelers offense under quarterback Aaron Rodgers and coach Mike McCarthy.
around_teams.summary: Freiermuth has flashed potential across his career without a defined featured role; the Post-Gazette projects the new Rodgers-McCarthy offense will lean on him heavily as camp opens in Latrobe.

sources.title: Steelers training camp countdown: Why Pat Freiermuth should finally become a key member of the offense

team_usa.title: Pochettino to Announce USMNT Decision Next Week
team_usa.latest_developments: Mauricio Pochettino said Friday, July 17, he will decide next week whether to stay on as coach of the U.S. men's national team, days after U.S. Soccer said it would 'take a break' before resolving his future.
team_usa.summary: Pochettino's contract, funded partly by billionaire donors, expired with the United States' round-of-16 exit from its home World Cup; the sporting-director job has sat vacant since Matt Crocker resigned in April.

sources.title: Poch to reveal decision on U.S. future next week

team_usa.title: Team USA Women Feted at Las Vegas SHE Weekend
team_usa.latest_developments: Dozens of Team USA women Olympians and Paralympians received personalized keys to the Las Vegas Strip on Thursday, July 16, at the inaugural SHE Weekend parade honoring American female athletes, ESPN reported.
team_usa.summary: The first SHE Weekend celebrated United States women Olympic and Paralympic athletes with a Las Vegas Strip parade and festivities built around them.

sources.title: Team USA gets keys to L.V. Strip at SHE Weekend

reading.title: IBM Misses, IBM's Mainframe Moat, IBM's Many AI Problems
reading.summary: Ben Thompson reads IBM's disappointing preliminary results as a warning that its durable mainframe franchise, long a moat, leaves the company poorly positioned as AI reshapes enterprise software.

reading.title: The OpenAI Bubble

reading.title: Why Reading Matters
reading.summary: Responding to Rose Horowitch's Atlantic essay 'The End of Reading Is Here,' Newport contends that sustained deep reading builds cognitive capacities that skimming and AI summaries cannot replicate.
